name: FILL: the name of the sound
kind: FILL: what the sound is, for example sound

device.descriptor: FILL: the id of the device descriptor the sound is for, for example korg/minilogue
device.vendor: FILL: the maker of the device
device.model: FILL: the model of the device

content.settings: FILL: the settings of the sound: an object of OSC addresses, each with its list of values

author.name: FILL: the name of the person who made the sound

license: FILL: the licence of the sound, as an SPDX identifier, for example CC0-1.0
